_comment: This dataset provides binary fresh/rotten labels across apples, bananas and oranges. The CNN is trained honestly on these 2 classes only — it is NOT trained to output 5 classes from binary data. The platform's 5-tier freshness category (Fresh/Good/Acceptable/Near Spoilage/Spoiled) is produced afterwards by app/services/scoring_service.py, which combines this binary CNN signal with OpenCV visual sub-scores, storage conditions, and product age. See docs/DATASET.md and docs/CNN_TRAINING.md for the full, documented mapping.
